ModMetaData.name: Tomahawk Missile Expansion
ModMetaData.author: YourNameHere
ModMetaData.description: Adds modular, Rimatomics-compatible cruise missiles to RimWorld — including high-explosive, EMP, and incendiary Tomahawk variants. Craft your own warheads, guidance systems, and missile assemblies, then fire them from launcher systems. Compatible with space and ground bases in the Odyssey DLC.
